title: Common bricks of the skeleton schemas
description: Definitions that the other schemas refer to. This schema by itself describes nothing.

tenant_name.description: Tenant name: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. The core computes the tenant from the credentials; the request body has no tenant field (TEN-2).

name.description: Object name in a manifest (metadata.name) and id in the tenant catalog.

dotted_name.description: A dotted name without a version: name of an action, plugin, tool, event.

type_name.description: Name of a task, event or message type with the version .vN, for example ops.investigate.v1 (MAN-3).

object_id.description: Core object id: a kind prefix and a ULID, for example t_01J9Z3M2Q8YB6V4N7T5K0C2D1E or bot_01J9Z3M2Q8YB6V4N7T5K0C2D1E.

attempt_ref.description: Reference to a task attempt: run_id of the form <task id>:<lease_no> (one runtime run per attempt lease, FEN-1; spec/ports/e4-agent-runtime.md).

file_ref.description: Reference to a file in the farm file store.

datetime.description: A UTC instant as RFC 3339 with Z, to seconds or fractions of a second.

schedule_slot.description: Schedule slot: a UTC instant to the minute (TIM-3).

duration.description: Duration with a unit: s, m, h or d, for example 15m.

eurocents.description: Money in euro cents as an integer: limits, reports and window sums (BUD-1, BUD-9). The usage of a call is stored in eur_micros.

eur_micros.description: Money in micro-euros as an integer, 1 EUR = 1 000 000: usage and reserve of one call, usage lines, daily reconciliation sums; no rounding for a call (BUD-9, D-87 (1)).

rule_id.description: Rule number in the registry conformance/requirements.yaml.

reason.description: Reason from the closed registry spec/model/reasons.yaml.

tz.description: Time zone name from the time zone database (TIM-3).

tier.description: Tier of a task or tool (PRM-4): 0 summary, ready summaries; 1 read, reading with closed parameters; 2 sandbox, a one-time container without network (since v0.2); 3 action, changing the world only through a request and a person's button.

data_mark.description: Data mark of the task; fixed at enqueue (PRM-5).

service_verb.description: Verb of an action on a catalog service (service.control, monitor/script_run).

alarm_severity.description: Severity of a farm alarm and of an alarm episode.

incident_severity.description: Severity of an incident; on the incident record only a person can change it (MGR-8).

principal_ref.description: Reference to a principal or an executor: kind and id. A person is recorded by the opaque principal id human:p_<ULID>; after the colon comes an id, not the person's name, and after the person leaves the records keep the same id (LCY-3). service names an external program, bot and worker name a bot identity and a worker, system is the service principal. For example human:p_01JB00000000000000000000A1, service:ci-exporter, system. Handles of the form human:alice are written only by manifests, examples and fixtures; the runner maps them to ids by evals/fixtures/seed.yaml or the fixture's given.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the form sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>. What is hashed and in which canonical form (RFC 8785) is set by spec/hashing.md.

problem.description: Port error: problem details per RFC 9457 with a reason member from the reason registry.

needs.description: Which permissions or groups were missing (enqueue denial; the HTTP binding returns it in a problem with status 422).
